en.bdb: The cow herds are there in the house of the master, the foolish person continues getting the churning sticks made for his own home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੋੜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਉਦਾਗਰਾਂ ਚਾਬਕ ਮੁਲਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: ghoRe sun saudhaagaraa(n) chaabak mul aae|

en.bdb: The horses are with the merchants and the foolish person roams around purchasing the whips.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਏ ਭਾਜਵਾੜ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਹੁ ਘਤਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhekh paraae bhaajavaaR ghar gaahu ghataae|

en.bdb: Foolish person creates stampede at his home only by seeing the harvest of others around the threshing floor.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹਟਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਦੇ ਸੁਨਿਆਰ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: suinaa haT saraaf dhe suniaar sadhaae|

en.bdb: The gold is with the gold merchant but the foolish calls for the goldsmith at his own home for preparing the jewellery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਫਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)dhar ddoiee naa lahai baahar baafaae|

en.bdb: He has no place at home, but goes on boasting outside.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਬਦਲ ਛਾਵ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਆਲਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh badhal chhaav hai kooRo aalaae ||11||

en.bdb: The apostate is unstable like the speedy cloud and goes on telling lies.
